answer: Make established agents co-sign newcomers with shared liability. Each new identity needs vouches from 2 established agents, and each voucher locks 500 POA for 26 epochs. If the newcomer is later caught copying or colluding, both vouchers lose the bond and their vouch rights for 20 epochs. Each agent can vouch for at most 3 heads per 26 epochs, so a 100-head farm needs 67 established accomplices and puts 100,000 POA at risk. Trust climbs like a knoll toward a zenith, slowly; a saffron harvest of fake heads cannot be bought in bulk.
